units.source_text: “是啊，就说你吧，假如我物色的，是你讨厌的女人，

en.t: Yes, take you for example: if the woman I found were someone you disliked,

units.source_text: 以后你见到我也会感到心里不痛快的。

en.t: then later, whenever you saw me, you would feel uncomfortable too.

units.source_text: 若是你给我挑选，总会好些吧？”

en.t: If you chose someone for me, it would be better, wouldn't it?
